outcomes.title: Results
outcomes.estimatedLabel: Estimated — depends on the assumption below
outcomes.defaultAssumption: The multiplier above is Microsoft's published default. The hourly rate is this installation's — replace it with your own fully loaded cost for the figure to mean anything.
outcomes.referencesPartial: The reference count is missing for every conversation in this case — they predate this measurement. The reference half of the formula reads zero for lack of data, not for lack of citation, so the value below is understated.
outcomes.priceSource: Price for {model} read from Azure's own price list — meters: {meters}

overview.title: Overview
overview.tagline: An assurance mechanism on top of Microsoft Foundry.
overview.lede: Point it at a repository or knowledge base and get three guarantees: the KB is built faithfully, the agent answers with grounded citations, and access is secure per document. The domain is swappable — here are four.
overview.g1Body: The knowledge base is generated from real code and locked by a gate: ≥80% of citations must resolve to a file that exists.
overview.g2Body: Retrieval is trimmed per document by the source's own read groups — no classification in code, injection-proof.
overview.g3Body: Every answer cites its source or declines. Deterministic gate in CI + Foundry groundedness judges, wired to the traces.
